pendekatan.title: Approach & Philosophy
pendekatan.subtitle: How we design stories and the principles guiding every creative decision.
whyParagraphs: Humans have shared stories for thousands of years. They're how we make sense of the world, pass down experiences, and share values across generations.
When you read a story, you don't just receive information. You feel what the characters feel, weigh their choices, and reflect on what you'd do in their place.
Interactive stories add another dimension: you don't just follow a journey, you shape it. That makes the experience more personal and reflective.
pendekatan.researchNote: Note: We don't claim interactive stories are the best method for all learning. Every approach has strengths and limits. We believe stories work well for topics involving empathy, reflection, and decision-making.
pendekatan.principlesIntro: Every Senara story follows a few key principles:

principles.title: 🪞 Reflection Over Instruction
principles.body: We don't tell readers what's 'right' or 'wrong'. Stories invite them to reflect on their own choices.

principles.title: Relevant Context
principles.body: Stories mirror real situations readers can relate to. Characters face real dilemmas — from mental health struggles to financial decisions — in contexts that feel familiar.

principles.title: 🔄 Learn Through Consequences
principles.body: Every choice has an impact. Readers can see outcomes without facing those risks in real life.

principles.title: 💬 Conversation Starter
principles.body: Our stories are built to spark discussion. Teachers and facilitators can use them as a launchpad for deeper conversation.

principles.title: 🎭 No 'Perfect' Ending
principles.body: Real life isn't binary. Stories show that every decision has trade-offs, and there's rarely a single 'correct' path.

pendekatan.processIntro: Each story goes through clear steps before publishing:

processSteps.title: Topic Research
processSteps.body: We study the theme across literature, expert interviews, and real stories from our community.

processSteps.title: Character & Scenario Development
processSteps.body: Characters get clear backstories. Scenarios are crafted so dilemmas feel real and choices aren't predictable.

processSteps.title: Writing & Branching
processSteps.body: Stories are written with multiple paths. Every choice should feel meaningful and lead to logical consequences.

processSteps.title: Content Review
processSteps.body: We review for accuracy, cultural sensitivity, and potential harm. Sensitive topics involve expert consultation.

processSteps.title: Testing & Iteration
processSteps.body: Early readers give feedback before launch. We revise based on their input.

pendekatan.ethicsIntro: Stories can influence how people think. That's why we follow these principles:
ethicsList: No misinformation or oversimplifying complex issues
We don't replace professional services (psychologists, counselors, etc.)
Stay open to criticism and keep improving based on feedback
pendekatan.ethicsOutro: For mental health topics, we always include info about professional support services. Our stories raise awareness, not diagnose or provide therapy.
pendekatan.interactiveIntro: We chose the visual-novel format for a reason:

interactivePoints.title: 🧠 Active Engagement
interactivePoints.body: Making choices forces readers to think actively, not just consume content.

interactivePoints.title: 🔁 Safe Exploration
interactivePoints.body: Readers can try multiple paths and see consequences without real-world risks.

interactivePoints.title: 🎯 Personalization
interactivePoints.body: Everyone's journey is slightly different, making it more personal and relevant.

interactivePoints.title: 💭 Inner Reflection
interactivePoints.body: Each choice is an inner question: 'What would I do?' This sparks deep reflection.

pendekatan.limitsIntro: We're honest about what Senara can and cannot do:
limitsBullets: Senara isn't a replacement for formal education. Our stories complement structured learning, not replace it.
Senara isn't a mental health service. Serious issues require professional support.
Our stories aren't perfect. We learn as we go. If you spot something harmful or inaccurate, please tell us.
closingParagraphs: We don't claim to have all the answers. We simply believe stories can bridge understanding between people and within ourselves.
Thanks for reading. If you have questions or feedback about our approach, reach out anytime.

safety.title: Safety & Support
safety.subtitle: A guide to staying emotionally safe while exploring Senara.
safety.disclaimerBody: Senara is not a substitute for professional mental health care. Our stories aim to raise literacy and awareness, not to diagnose, treat, or provide therapy. If you’re experiencing mental health challenges, please reach out to a professional.
safety.whenHelpTitle: When to Reach Out for Help
safety.whenHelpIntro: Reading sensitive topics can stir up strong feelings. That’s normal. Still, there are moments when talking to a trained professional is the best next step.
safety.whenHelpListTitle: Contact professional support right away if you:
whenHelpList: Have thoughts of hurting yourself or others
Feel overwhelmed and can’t cope on your own
Notice drastic changes in sleep, appetite, or daily routines
Feel isolated and as if no one is there to listen
Rely on alcohol or other substances to numb your feelings
Feel that a story is too heavy and it affects your daily life
safety.whenHelpOutro: Asking for help is a sign of strength, not weakness.
safety.hotlinesIntro: Here are trusted organizations you can contact whenever you need support:

sejiwa.title: Sejiwa (Indonesian MoH)
sejiwa.desc: Mental health counseling from the Ministry of Health. Free, 24/7.

itl.title: Into The Light Indonesia
itl.desc: Suicide prevention community offering resources and peer support.

pulih.title: Yayasan Pulih
pulih.desc: Counseling services for trauma recovery and mental wellness.

tepsa.title: Child Social Service Line (TePSA)
tepsa.desc: 24/7 helpline for children and teens who need assistance.

komnas.title: Komnas Perempuan
komnas.desc: Support for women experiencing violence or in need of protection.

safety.safeTipsIntro: Some Senara stories explore heavy topics. These tips can help you take care of your emotional wellbeing:
safeTips: Pause whenever you need. If a story feels too intense, you don’t have to finish it. Take a break, or stop entirely.
Watch the content warnings. Sensitive stories include a warning at the beginning. Read it first before you continue.
Set the right moment. Choose a comfortable time and place. Avoid reading when you’re exhausted or emotionally drained.
Talk to someone. After a heavy story, sharing how you feel with a friend, family member, or trusted person can help.
Ground yourself. If you feel overwhelmed, try grounding: deep breaths, then notice 5 things you can see, 4 you can touch, 3 you can hear.
Write it out. Journaling afterwards can help you process thoughts and emotions that surface.
safety.parentsIntro: If you’re using Senara with your child or students:
parentsTips: Preview stories first. Read the story yourself before recommending it so you can gauge the fit.
Guide and discuss. For sensitive topics, consider co-reading and reflecting together afterwards.
Check the age labels. Each story includes an age recommendation (e.g., 13+). Use it as a baseline.
safety.supportBody1: Whatever you’re going through, there are people who care and want to support you. Please reach out.
safety.supportBody2: If you find any Senara content that feels unsafe or needs improvement, let us know. Your feedback really matters to us.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: How we collect, use, and protect your information.
privacy.summary: Summary: We don’t collect personal data. No logins, no individual tracking. Senara is built with privacy in mind.

dataCollection.title: 1. Data We Collect
dataCollection.intro: Senara follows a minimal data collection principle. We never ask you to:
list: Create an account or log in
Provide your name, email, or other personal information
Grant access to location, camera, or microphone
dataCollection.outro: Because there’s no account system, we don’t store any personal data on our servers.

analytics.title: 2. Analytics
analytics.intro: We use Umami Analytics, a privacy-friendly, open-source platform. Umami doesn’t use cookies and doesn’t track individual users.
collectedList: Country (based on IP, but IP itself isn’t stored)
analytics.note: All data is aggregate and anonymous. We can’t identify individual users from it.
analytics.whyBody: To understand which stories resonate most, which pages need improvement, and how people discover Senara, so we can build better experiences.

cookies.title: 3. Cookies & Local Storage
cookies.cookiesBody: Senara does not use cookies for tracking. Umami Analytics doesn’t use cookies either.
cookies.localIntro: We rely on your browser’s Local Storage to keep:
localList: Save files so you can continue later
cookies.localNote: This data lives only on your device, not on our servers. You can erase it anytime via your browser settings.

thirdParty.title: 4. Third-Party Services
thirdParty.intro: Senara relies on a few third-party services:
list: Umami Analytics – Privacy-first analytics (no cookies, no individual tracking)
Tailwind CSS CDN – Styling assets (no data collection)
Google Fonts – Typography (may collect minimal data per Google’s policy)
Trakteer – Donations (if you donate, Trakteer’s privacy policy applies)
thirdParty.outro: We never sell, rent, or share user data with third parties for commercial purposes.

security.title: 5. Data Security
security.p1: Because we don’t collect personal data, the risk of a data breach is extremely low. Our site uses HTTPS to encrypt all traffic.
security.p2: Anything stored in your browser’s Local Storage is protected by the browser itself and is only accessible to the Senara site.

children.title: 6. Children’s Privacy
children.p1: Senara can be used by children with parental guidance. Since we don’t collect personal data, there’s no risk of us unintentionally storing children’s data.
children.p2: Every story includes a clear age recommendation. We encourage parents to review the content before allowing their child to read it.

changes.title: 7. Policy Changes
changes.p1: We may update this privacy policy from time to time. Significant changes will be announced on this page with a visible date.
changes.p2: If we ever introduce features that require data collection (like accounts), we’ll update this policy and request explicit user consent.

contact.title: 8. Contact Us

about.title: The Story Behind Senara
about.subtitle: How a simple idea grew into an interactive storytelling platform.
about.originP2: We kept finding important material whose delivery bored people before they finished reading. Meanwhile, people willingly spent hours on stories: novels, webtoons, dramas.
about.originP3: That led to a question: what if life lessons were wrapped in exciting stories? Not lectures, not modules, but experiences you can feel.
about.originP4: Our first story was a small experiment. The response surprised us. People discussed, shared, and said “this feels so relatable.”
about.problemTitle: The Problems We're Trying to Solve
about.prob1Title: Important topics are often delivered in boring formats
about.prob1Desc: Mental health, financial literacy, critical thinking. All important, yet often packaged in ways that are hard to digest.
about.prob2Desc: Many people know the theory but can't apply it because they've never “felt” the situation. Interactive stories help bridge that gap.
about.prob3Desc: Online courses, workshops, books... they all cost money. We believe access to meaningful experiences shouldn't depend on finances.
about.missionStatement: Make meaningful experiences accessible to everyone, with no cost and no strings attached.
about.missionP1: Senara is a nonprofit platform. We don't sell anything. Every story is free, now and forever.
about.missionP2: No freemium, no trials. Completely free. No investors demanding profit, no revenue targets. Every story is created by caring volunteers.
about.visionQuote: We dream of Senara becoming the largest library of meaningful stories in the world.
about.visionP1: A place where teachers find engaging material. Parents teach values through stories. Anyone can learn from fictional characters before facing similar situations in real life.
about.visionP2: We know it takes time. But every new story and every reader we touch is a step toward that future.
about.val1Desc: We're learning as we go. Imperfect, but always progressing.
about.val2Desc: Senara exists because of contributors. Every story is collaborative.
about.val3Desc: We don't chase numbers. We chase meaningful change.
about.val4Desc: A good story is one everyone can understand.
about.val5Desc: We write for humans, not algorithms.
about.closingP1: Senara is still very young. Many things aren't perfect, but we're constantly learning.
about.closingP2: We believe stories can change how people see the world. We'll keep creating stories that matter.
about.closingP3: Thank you for being part of this journey.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.subtitle: Answers to frequently asked questions about Senara.

whatIs.a: Senara is an interactive visual novel storytelling platform. You read stories, make choices, and each decision shapes your own path. Our stories cover mental health, financial literacy, and various life skills.

forWhom.a: Senara is for anyone who wants to learn through stories. We have stories for teens (13+), young adults, and general audiences. Teachers and facilitators can also use Senara as discussion material in class or workshops.

isFree.a: Yes, 100% free. Not freemium, not a trial. All stories are accessible without payment, now and forever. Senara is a nonprofit platform built by a volunteer community.

needAccount.q: Do I need to create an account?
needAccount.a: No. You can start reading stories without logging in or registering. Your progress is saved automatically in your browser. Account features may come in the future for cross-device sync.

replacePro.q: Can Senara replace a psychologist or counselor?
replacePro.a: No. Senara is not a substitute for professional mental health services. Our stories aim to increase literacy and awareness, not to diagnose or treat. If you need professional help, please contact a qualified psychologist or counselor.

whoMakes.q: Who creates the stories on Senara?
whoMakes.a: Stories are created by a volunteer team from various backgrounds: writers, designers, developers, and subject matter experts. Every story goes through a review process to ensure accuracy and quality.

safeForTeens.q: Is Senara content safe for teenagers?
safeForTeens.a: Yes. Every story has a clear age label (e.g., 13+). We avoid explicit content and always provide warnings for sensitive topics. Parents and teachers can review story descriptions before recommending them.

forTeachers.a: Teachers can use Senara stories as discussion material, reflection assignments, or ice breakers. Just pick a story that fits your topic, have students read together or independently, then discuss the choices and lessons afterward.

devices.q: Can I access it on mobile or only on computer?
devices.a: Senara works on all devices: phone, tablet, or computer. Just open your browser and visit our website. No app download needed.

privacy.a: We don't collect personal data. No login, no individual tracking. We only use anonymous analytics to understand which stories are most popular. Your story progress is stored locally in your own browser.

support.a: Several ways: (1) Share Senara with friends or communities, (2) Donate via Trakteer to support operations, or (3) Join as a contributor if you have skills in writing, design, or development.

contribute.title: Contribute to Senara
contribute.subtitle: Help us create meaningful stories for more people.
contribute.intro: Senara is built by a volunteer community who believes stories can change how people learn. We're always looking for people who want to share their skills and time to create something meaningful.
contribute.rolesIntro: Every Senara story is a collaboration of various skills. Here are the roles we're always looking for:

writer.title: Story Writer
writer.desc: Write interactive story scripts with dialogue, choices, and multiple paths. You'll work with the team to ensure stories are engaging and meaningful.

artist.title: Illustrator & Designer
artist.desc: Create characters, backgrounds, and visual assets for stories. Visual styles can vary from anime-style to simple illustrations.

editor.title: Editor & Reviewer
editor.desc: Review scripts for clarity, accuracy, and content sensitivity. Help ensure story quality before publication.

educator.title: Education Consultant
educator.desc: Help validate content from a subject matter perspective. For example, psychologists for mental health stories, or finance experts for financial literacy stories.

developer.title: Developer
developer.desc: Help with platform development, new features, or technical integration. Familiar with JavaScript and web development.

outreach.title: Community & Outreach
outreach.desc: Help spread Senara to the right communities, manage social media, or build partnerships with other organizations.

contribute.noExpNote: 💡 No experience? No problem. We're open to beginners who want to learn. What matters is enthusiasm and commitment to contribute.
contribute.processIntro: The contribution process at Senara is designed to be flexible and not overwhelming:

intro.title: Get to Know Each Other
intro.desc: Contact us via email or form. Tell us a bit about yourself, your skills, and interests. No formal CV needed.

matching.title: Discussion & Matching
matching.desc: We'll chat to understand your availability and preferences. Then we'll find a project or team that fits.

start.title: Start Contributing
start.desc: You'll join a small team to work on one story. Communication via group chat, with flexible timelines.

publish.title: Review & Publish
publish.desc: Once the story is done, the team reviews together. When ready, the story is published with credits for all contributors.

contribute.benefitsIntro: Senara is a nonprofit platform, so we can't offer payment. But there are other things you can gain:

community.desc: Network with other creators and educators

experience.title: Experience
experience.desc: Learn the interactive story creation process

credit.title: Credit
credit.desc: Your name appears on every story you help create

impact.desc: Your work helps people learn important things

team.title: Senara Team
team.subtitle: The people behind the stories you read.
team.intro: Senara is built by a small team that believes stories have the power to teach important topics in a way that touches the heart. We're not a big company, just a group of people who care.
team.whyP1: We saw many people around us struggling to understand important topics in life—mental health, digital literacy, finance, and soft skills—but not knowing where to start. The available information often felt preachy, boring, or irrelevant.
team.whyP2: We believe there's a better way: through stories. Stories that make us feel "that's so me", that make us think without feeling lectured, and that anyone can access for free.
team.whyP3: Senara was born from a simple belief: everyone deserves to learn about important things in life, in a humane and free way.
team.bioCEO: Experienced in financial regulation and multinational FMCG. Co-founder of Diceritain (30K+ users). Psychology and product management background.
team.bioCTO: 6+ years in tech companies across Australia, Singapore, US, and Japan. Building products used by hundreds of thousands of users.
team.bioCOO: Managing talent development for 50K+ employees at a state-owned holding company. Top graduate. L&D and corporate learning background.
team.jobPrim: Silang.id · Freelance Graphic Designer & Illustrator · BISINDO Interpreter
team.bioPrim: Visual creator with 4+ years experience in branding, social media, and multimedia. Certified Indonesian Sign Language (BISINDO) interpreter. Active in the Deaf community through Fantasi Tuli and GKI Pondok Indah.
